understood_as: A system-level comparison of PPO, task-teacher Dual PPO, and DreamerV3 across the same three transition-defect fixtures. This manifest freezes the scientific question, estimands, panels, seed roles, and selection boundaries; it does not authorize implementation, smoke, training, evaluation, checkpoint writes, dependency changes, or queue launch.
gate_semantics: All listed gates are necessary but not sufficient. Satisfying them grants no authority; a separately reviewed amendment must explicitly authorize each activity.
pending_fields: pinned DreamerV3 implementation source and adaptation audit
normal qualification thresholds and tie rules
normal pretraining and adaptation environment-step budgets
resolved code, config, dependency, panel, and storage hashes
scientific_question: When an agent pretrained under normal rules encounters a new transition defect, how does the learning system affect whether observed exceptions become repeatable real-environment exploitation while preserving normal-task performance?

hypotheses.experience_amplification: Dreamer may reuse rare defect transitions through model learning and imagination, reducing real environment experience needed for adoption.
hypotheses.normal_rule_dominance: A model dominated by normal pretraining data may underfit rare defect transitions and delay adoption.
hypotheses.model_exploitation: A policy may exploit world-model error rather than the actual engine; imagined return alone never counts as defect exploitation.

external_sources.title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models
external_sources.verified_role: Supports the DreamerV3 system description: a learned world model, actor, and critic trained concurrently from replayed experience, with behaviour improved through imagined futures.

external_sources.boundary: Candidate provenance only. This design does not select or inspect an implementation revision; a commit pin and adaptation audit remain mandatory before coding.

evidence_basis.motivation: TICK and CRAFT task-teacher update-versus-freeze contrasts and the distinct PACK imitation-on-versus-off contrast were positive on average, but results varied by learner seed and did not establish a mechanism or guarantee normal-performance preservation.

comparison_axis.unit: algorithm system, not a single isolated mechanism
comparison_axis.causal_boundary: PPO, Dual PPO, and Dreamer differ in objectives, data reuse, state, architecture, and update schedules. Cross-system differences must not be attributed to a world model, replay, or teacher alone.

Dual-PPO-task.reason: Use one task-relevant teacher condition across all environments. Do not select D-on or another teacher variant post hoc by environment.
Dual-PPO-task.role: PPO plus online task-teacher updating and imitation guidance

DreamerV3.role: world-model actor-critic system with replay and imagined rollouts
DreamerV3.implementation_source_rule: Select and license-audit one pinned implementation before coding; record every adaptation and resolved dependency. No external implementation text may be used before this gate.

learner_seeds.rule: The same nominal seed IDs are used for bookkeeping and balanced coverage in every algorithm x environment cell. They do not by themselves create statistical pairing across algorithms. Development seeds never enter scientific estimates, and main seeds are not replaced after failures.

randomness_contract.training_rng: Algorithm-specific streams derived from the declared seed ID; stream equality across different systems is neither assumed nor claimed.
randomness_contract.within_system_fork: Fixed and mutant branches clone the same source state for one algorithm, environment, and seed, then receive branch-specific environment randomness under a schedule frozen before execution.
randomness_contract.evaluation_coupling: All systems use the same ordered start panels and predeclared evaluation RNG schedule within an environment.
randomness_contract.between_system_analysis: Nominally aligned seed IDs may be plotted together for blocked descriptive comparison, but between-system uncertainty is not treated as statistically paired unless a later analysis plan justifies that estimator before outcomes.

selection_contract.normal_qualification: Each algorithm must first learn the fixed-kernel task independently in every environment. Thresholds, checkpoints, and tie rules must be frozen in an implementation amendment before any development run.
selection_contract.failure_rule: A system that does not qualify normal performance in an environment is reported as not qualified there; its defect exploitation is not interpreted as an adaptation comparison.

main_protocol.source_pretraining: Train one fixed-kernel source independently for every algorithm x environment x held-out learner seed.
main_protocol.fork: Clone the complete algorithm state at the qualified source checkpoint into fixed continuation and mutant adaptation branches.
complete_state: replay contents, cursor, capacity, and sampler RNG when applicable
world-model, actor, critic, and latent-state training state when applicable

budget_contract.status: must be frozen after implementation smoke and throughput measurement, before normal-only development

evaluation_contract.episode_accounting_note: Evaluation episodes improve within-policy measurement precision; the independent replication unit remains the learner seed.
evaluation_contract.real_kernel_rule: Success, return, trigger, and exploitation are scored only from actual fixed or mutant kernel transitions. Imagination metrics are diagnostic and cannot satisfy an exploitation endpoint.
evaluation_contract.trace_and_replay: Retain complete state/action traces and validate defect events with the existing independent conservation replay contract.
evaluation_contract.oracle_independence_boundary: The conservation replay is independent of the actor, teacher, world model, and transition-kernel call path, but it is maintained in the same project and is not external ground truth.
evaluation_contract.additional_independence_gate: Before execution, freeze hand-specified positive and negative transition fixtures for every defect and obtain a fresh reviewer sign-off on the oracle formulas without exposing condition outcomes.
evaluation_contract.missing_result_rule: Preserve failures and missing artifacts. Do not silently rerun or drop a learner seed.

estimands.within_system_adaptation: U_a = C(pi_a,mutant-trained evaluated on mutant) - C(pi_a,fixed-trained evaluated on mutant), paired by environment and learner seed
estimands.between_system_contrast: Delta_U(a,b) = mean_s(U_a,s) - mean_s(U_b,s) within each environment. Nominal seed alignment is descriptive blocking, not assumed statistical pairing across algorithms.
estimands.normal_preservation: Fixed-kernel success and discounted return of the mutant-trained final policy, reported beside exploitation
estimands.task_value: Mutant-kernel success and discounted return; lower trigger exposure alone is not success
latency: real environment transitions to first observed defect trigger
real environment transitions from first trigger to first later checkpoint with real exploitation
a stable-repetition rule to be frozen before execution
dreamer_diagnostics: world-model prediction error on defect-trigger transitions versus matched normal transitions
imagined versus real return gap for selected exploit trajectories
fraction of replay and imagined samples attributable to post-deployment experience

required: source, fixed continuation, and mutant adaptation together
normal success and return beside exploitation
first trigger and later adoption latencies
failed qualification, interrupted runs, resumes, and missing artifacts
prohibited_claims: Dreamer difference is caused by the world model alone
imagined exploitation is real defect exploitation
evaluation episode count is the learner sample size
one environment establishes a general algorithm ranking
a normally unqualified system failed specifically at defect adaptation

gates_before_implementation: Pin and license-audit one DreamerV3 implementation or write a separately reviewed independent implementation contract.
Freeze observation/action adapters without adding oracle or defect identity.
Freeze complete candidate registries and normal qualification thresholds.
Define exact mode/sample semantics for every actor and verify the same real kernel is selected.
Forecast checkpoint, replay, trace, and active predecessor-successor storage under the repository capacity policy.
gates_before_any_main_run: Pass unit and one-update smoke tests for every algorithm x environment cell.
Demonstrate checkpoint-resume identity including replay and Dreamer state.
Measure throughput and freeze non-null environment-step budgets without mutant-result tuning.
Freeze the stable-repetition latency rule and all checkpoint evaluation times before any mutant result is observed.
Qualify normal learning on both development seeds in every opened cell.
Commit an executable amendment with code hashes, configs, budgets, RAID paths, evaluation hashes, and explicit execution authority.
